name: Fear
description: Make an attack against the MD of a creature. On a hit, the creature is frightened.
empower: pEmpower. The creature does not know you attempted to magically influence it when the spell ends or fails.

name: Flames
description:
You may produce 1 of the following effects:
  • Attack. Make an attack against a target’s PD within range. On a hit, the target suffers 1 fire damage and begins burning.
  • Fire Orb. A fiery orb appears harmlessly in your hand that sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for 10 more feet. The spell ends if you dismiss it as a free action, you cast it again, or you perform the attack effect.
empower: pEmpower. Increase the damage of the attack by 1.

name: Fly
description: The target gains a flying speed of 10 feet.
empower:
Empower. Choose one of the following effects:
  • pppHover. The flying speed allows the target to hover.
  • pSwiftness. The flying speed increases by 10 feet.
